description: Change a component type that is there without moving any value in its blocks: its displayName; addFields puts new sub-fields after the ones it has (the shape of add_component_type's fields; a new key is the lowercase, hyphenated name, and a name whose key the type has is refused), editFields relabels the ones it has by key (displayName, helpText — null takes it away — required). A group sub-field's entry in editFields takes addFields and editFields of its own, for the sub-fields of its items, by the same rules. Every components field that allows the type takes the change at once. A sub-field's key and type stay as they are; taking one out or changing its type is done in Mapled.

addFields.description: New sub-fields, after the ones it has. A type holds up to 20.

group.description: For type group only: the sub-fields of each of its items (simple types, no group inside) and up to how many items it holds; a block holds it as a list of objects keyed by those sub-fields' keys.

relation.description: Required for type relation, not allowed otherwise. A block holds a record id, or an array of them for many.

cardinality.description: one (default): a block holds one linked record; many: a list of them (their order is kept).

onDelete.description: What a delete of a linked record does: restrict — the linked record can't be deleted while a block links to it; nullify — the links are cleared. Default: restrict when the sub-field is required, nullify otherwise.

target.description: Key of the collection its blocks link into (see get_schema) — not one of the site's signed-in users.

editFields.description: Sub-fields it has, by key, and what changes in each.

addFields.description: For a group sub-field: new sub-fields of its items, after the ones it has.

editFields.description: For a group sub-field: sub-fields of its items, by key, and what changes in each.

key.description: The sub-field's key, as get_schema lists it.
The component type's key, as get_schema lists it under componentTypes.
